title: Chapter 121 We Surrender
content:
Chapter 121 We Surrender

A few days later.

Lu Daosheng, who was in the gentle land for several days, finally remembered his purpose.

Looking at Yan Lingyun, who was sleeping on her chest because of overwork, Lu Daosheng stood up carefully, and with a thought, the clothes were put on automatically.

It's so good to have a wife.

What kind of life did I live before?

Thinking of the days I spent before, Lu Daosheng felt a deep regret.

If I had known this, I should have been upgrading the moment I first obtained the system until I found my wife.

But he just thought about it.

Because he really didn't know what Yan Lingyun thought at that time.

After all, it's still too cowardly.

Don't dare to face the truth.

I can only choose to go with the flow.

Fortunately, Yan Lingyun did not let him down.

Everything is already moving in the best direction.

Looking at Yan Lingyun's white and tender face, Lu Daosheng couldn't help but kiss her gently, and then said softly: "Lingyun, let's go first for your husband. For the next road, let's go first for your husband. You explore, see you in the upper world."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng disappeared from the spot.

At this time, Yan Lingyun's eyebrows trembled slightly and she slowly opened her eyes.

His eyes were full of tenderness.

"Daosheng,,,"

On the other side.

Not far away, there is a slightly smaller but still magnificent palace.

A beautiful woman in blue was lying flat on the ground, surrounded by cold air, and a mysterious aura was flowing with the captivating cold air.

Princess of the Divine Dynasty.

Lu Xue.

As her luck is so great, she has no choice but to say about her talent and qualifications.

Although Lu Xue has hardly fought, Lu Xue's strength cannot be underestimated at all.

She seemed to be harmless, and now she had reached the realm of God Emperor, and she had a vague trend of breakthrough.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng in the dark nodded immediately.

He is worthy of being his daughter.

This cultivation speed is up to her mother.

Yan Lingyun's cultivation speed was even more terrifying. If Yan Lingyun had not pursued the ultimate realm, Yan Lingyun would have probably ascended to the top.

But even so, Yan Lingyun's strength is still at the peak of the mortal realm.

It is not far from becoming an immortal.

After a moment, Lu Xue slowly breathed a sigh of relief and then stood up.

"I practiced for a while today, and it's so awesome."

Almost every day, Lu Xue will do ideological work for herself.

If it were someone else, this family background would have been ruined, and she would have been a daughter.

Do you think there is still a need for cultivation?

But Lu Xue didn't want that. She would never forget the hard days when the deserted city was poor and her father pretended to be weak and had not yet shown her strength.

At that time, I dreamed that I wanted to practice hard and become a strong man.

Now that there is conditions, we must not forget our roots.

She did not forget her original intention.

This is also the main reason why Lu Xue has no bottleneck in her cultivation.

At this moment, Lu Daosheng's figure slowly appeared from the hall.

"Xiaoxue."

When Lu Daosheng was seen, Lu Xue was slightly stunned, and then said in surprise: "Dad, are you here to see me?!"

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "Yes, I'm here to see you."

Looking at Lu Daosheng, Lu Xue said directly: "Dad, just say it, what are you going to do?"

At this time, Lu Xue revealed the truth in one sentence.

I know very well what my father's temperament is.

It seems that I am about to run away again.

Moreover, Lu Daosheng was full of her mother's smell. Lu Xue was not a fool, she was just embarrassed to point it out.

When Lu Daosheng heard his daughter's words, he immediately smiled awkwardly.

"Well, Xiaoxue, Dad, I have something to do."

"You have to be with your mother. She misses you very much after you haven't been by her for the past few years."

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded.

"Dad, I know."

If Lu Xue was a little jealous of Yan Lingyun at the beginning, then now Lu Xue has completely accepted Yan Lingyun during the days after Yan Lingyun brought her to the Divine Dynasty.

Family affection is the most unforgettable.

Yan Lingyun was so good at Lu Xue that she was so good.

Afterwards, Lu Daosheng left with confidence.

Above the sky.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's aura became stronger and stronger, and a fairy gate with a vague aura slowly condensed from a distance.

Standing in front of the immortal gate, Lu Daosheng stopped.

Looking back at the end, I looked at the world behind me.

There are no worries in the deserted city.

He has temporarily handed over the Huangcheng to Awei, Gu Chen and An Xing for temporary management.

Lu Daosheng was very relieved about these three people.

What's more, he has a lot of talents in the deserted city and the backup plan he left behind. No matter what, nothing will happen to the deserted city.

And the Divine Dynasty has no crisis for the time being.

What is dangerous is the existence targeted by the Divine Dynasty.

However, with Lu Daosheng's current eyesight, he naturally saw something.

Unexpectedly, this world is also a crouching tiger, hidden dragon, and even the Divine Dynasty is not an invincible existence.

Under calm, undercurrents surge.

Many terrifying existences hidden in the dark are about to move.

After a moment of silence, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled.

His wife is not a good person, and he doesn't have to worry about those who exist.

Some ghosts and monsters cannot threaten their wives at all, and at most they will be a little trouble.

What he really needs to worry about is the unknown dangers that even his wife Yan Lingyun cannot feel.

This is exactly the purpose of Lu Daosheng's trip.

No matter who the other party is or what his purpose is, anyone who dares to touch his woman will definitely not have a good end.

At the same time, Lu Daosheng will also learn about Yan Lingyun's past.

His wife's life experience is really a bit complicated.

Finally, he wants to promote the name of his deserted city in the upper world.

He wants to make his deserted city visible in all the heavens and worlds.

Looking at the immortal gate in front of him, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly.

Boom!

Accompanied by a deafening explosion, the entire immortal gate shattered.

The next moment, a rich immortal aura slowly overflowed from behind.

Immortal world, I, Lu Daosheng, am here.

No, it should be me again.

.........

At the same time, at the border of Tianlin Star Region.

At this moment, the atmosphere here was extremely depressing. The master of Tianlin Temple stood quietly in the void with several elders.

Behind him were some people from other forces.

But there were no more than fifty people in total.

Looking at the mighty army of the Divine Dynasty in front of them, everyone in Tianlin Temple suddenly felt a strong sense of oppression.

It's finally here.

At this time, Wang Zhen slowly stepped out of the Divine Dynasty army and looked at the few people in Tianlin Temple in front of him.

Wang Zhen frowned slightly, but still said: "Tianlin Temple, will you surrender or not?"

It's still necessary to go through the scene.

"Surrender!"

Hearing this, Wang Zhen nodded and said: "Okay, since you don't surrender, then..."

......

There was a moment of silence in the field.

"Ah?!"

Wang Zhen reacted suddenly and said in disbelief: "What did you say?"

Surrender?

What a joke, is it so easy?

There must be a bomb!

Thinking of this, Wang Zhen stared at the people in Tianlin Star Region with a serious expression.

"I advise you not to play any tricks. In the face of absolute strength, you in Tianlin Star Region have no power to resist."

Wang Zhen said in a deep voice.

However, Luo Ming, the master of Tianlin Palace, spread his hands and said: "I am telling the truth. We surrender. We can't win anyway. Why bother?"

Hearing this, Wang Zhen was speechless.

It felt like a punch on cotton.

He came all the way with a large army, but the other side surrendered directly.

Thinking of this, Wang Zhen suddenly felt depressed.

Otherwise, don't accept their surrender?

Although it is a bit immoral, Wang Zhen is somewhat tempted.

At this moment, a majestic voice came from the depths of the starry sky.

Hear the voice before seeing the person.

"Surrender? No way!!"
